project_type: Interactive event-agency production and commercial workflow demo

characterization.problem_domain: Transform event brief into a reviewed production scope and human-priced quotation with client-facing output.
characterization.intended_users: Event agency producers and commercial reviewers (domain inferred from README, not user-tested claims).
characterization.intended_commercialization: One-time source and workflow transfer to a purchasing organization, not operating a seller-owned SaaS.

workflow.goal: Create project and capture facts, unknowns, scope, optional budget
Review seven production zones and explicitly accept required needs
Stage accepted needs as private unpriced candidates
Human prices/costs, three LEAN/SIGNATURE/FLAGSHIP scenarios and finance reconciliation
Simulated approval decisions with warnings/blockers; not authenticated reviewers
Local issue/versioned R1/R2 public PDF snapshots excluding internal data

contribution.user_self_description: Vibecoder; coordinates AI-assisted creation rather than claiming hand-written engineering.
contribution.personal_testing_and_iteration: User has described overseeing project and QA in conversation, but exact individual actions need a first-person confirmation if attributed.
contribution.permitted_safe_statement: An AI-assisted product project directed and reviewed by the portfolio owner; attribution of specific design/implementation contributions remains to be clarified.
contribution.no_invention: Do not claim original hand-coding, professional product adoption, external buyer acceptance, delivered client work, revenue, or production launch.

reproducible_test_evidence.source: README & buyer-handover index, historical bounded verified runs
reproducible_test_evidence.note: Test counts are linked to stated source and local rehearsal, not independently re-run in this portfolio intake.

showcase_concept.title: FROM BRIEF TO SHOW
showcase_concept.presentation: Interactive guided product journey rather than code gallery or generic case-study cards.
interactions: Reveal why a missing fact stays unknown
Inspect pricing stage without implying automated pricing
